d: A procedural co-op space sandbox where players can build their own space ships out of dynamically scalable blocks. Fight epic space battles, explore, mine, trade, wage wars and build your own empire to save your galaxy from being torn apart by an unknown enemy.

rv.t: 깨작깨작 아직도 업데이트 하는게 신기한게임. 게임 자체만 두고봤을때는 그냥 멍때리고 할만함
